intent: Evolve the existing claude-defaults repo into a centralized hub for global Claude Code config — structured tool/MCP logging with redaction, expanded destructive-pattern safety hooks, anti-rationalization Stop hook wired by default, hybrid install (symlinks for content + jq-merge for settings.json), full test harness. Hard invariant: hooks must NEVER break a tool call.
verdict_reasoning: PR is functionally working (32/32 validate, hooks fire end-to-end). But 10 P1 findings include three real correctness bugs (call_id pairing structurally broken, hooks-merge silent data loss, python3-absent install corruption), one real security gap (DB_PASSWORD/URL/GH-PAT/STS-key redaction misses), structural test coverage gaps (post-event hook untested), and a documentation trap (redaction extension points to wrong file).

p1_findings.title: call_id never matches between pre and post log rows; documented join is structurally broken
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Generate cid = _call_id() once before pre's try block; reuse in tempfile and payload. In post, read parts[0] from pair file as the call_id.

p1_findings.title: jq hooks merge silently drops existing user hook entries on first install
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Replace `.hooks = ($a.hooks // {}) * ($b.hooks // {})` with a per-event-key array concatenation that unions and dedupes.

p1_findings.title: Redaction patterns and truncation logic duplicated verbatim from redact.py + jsonl-write.py with no enforcement
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Extract shared module hooks/lib/_log_core.py, import from all three files. Preserves single-fork perf win; eliminates drift risk.

p1_findings.title: Redaction bypass: compound env vars (DB_PASSWORD), URL passwords, GitHub fine-grained PATs, AWS STS keys all pass through
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Add patterns: `[A-Z0-9_]*(?:PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN|KEY)\s*=\s*\S+`; URL userinfo `://[^:@\s]+:([^@\s]{4,})@`; `github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}`; `\bASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b`. Apply same updates to log_tool_call.py copy until P1-3 lands.

p1_findings.title: log-tool-calls.sh post event never invoked by any test
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Add a paired pre/post test fixture and assert the post row schema (event=post, exit_status, duration_ms ≥ wall time).

p1_findings.title: 6 of 7 safety-block.sh patterns untested
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Reuse the parametrized table from /tmp/test_safety_block.sh (already had 16 block + 9 allow cases) inside tests/test-hooks.sh.

p1_findings.title: Strip-quoted-strings false-positive suppression untested
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Add cases: `echo "rm -rf foo"` → exit 0; `echo "dd of=/dev/disk0"` → exit 0; real `rm -rf /tmp/x` (single-quoted absent) → still exit 2.

p1_findings.title: Pre/Post pair-file pairing never round-tripped in tests
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Add test that fires pre+sleep+post for a known input, asserts pair file existed between calls and was deleted by post, asserts duration_ms in expected range.

p1_findings.title: docs/LOGGING.md redaction-extension procedure points to wrong file
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Update procedure to specify both files until P1-3 lands; after P1-3, point only to shared _log_core.py.

p1_findings.title: install.sh leaves ~/.claude/settings.json absent if python3 missing during merge validation
p1_findings.suggested_fix: Replace `python3 -m json.tool < .tmp` validation with `jq . < .tmp >/dev/null` (jq is already required, no python3 dependency).

p2_findings_summary: _truncate_output edge case: stdout/stderr ≤256 bytes can still exceed max_bytes (correctness, 0.97)
bash -c '<dangerous>' bypass of safety-block.sh: documented limitation but specific bypass class not called out (security, adversarial, 0.99)
scripts/redact-existing-logs.py referenced in docs but does not exist (agent-native, 0.97)
log-tool-calls.sh exec fails if python3 absent — needs guard (reliability, 0.85)
Non-ENOSPC OSError silently produces None return (correctness, reliability, kieran-python, 0.85)
safety-block.sh 9 sequential greps add ~30ms back per Bash call (performance, 0.78)
Edit deny missing for ~15 paths that have Write deny (security, 0.88)
Missing credential patterns: Stripe, Slack, GCP service-account, standalone AWS secret (security, 0.85)
Log filename uses local time but ts uses UTC — date-boundary inconsistency (kieran-python, 0.82)
log-rotate.sh gzip race: truncated .gz + && rm can lose original (reliability, 0.78)
Concurrent identical tool calls collide on pair_path (adversarial, 0.92) — may be acceptable if AGENT_TEAMS rare
SessionEnd-only rotation can't fire mid-session for long agent loops (adversarial, 0.88)
redact.py + jsonl-write.py orphaned in production path (resolves with P1-3) (maintainability, 0.85)
GH token mustnot uses 9-char prefix instead of full 40-char (testing, 0.85)
p3_findings_summary: common.sh is dead code — zero callers (maintainability, 0.95)
block-rm-rf.sh + block-push-main.sh subsumed by safety-block.sh (caveat: removing block-push-main loosens policy) (maintainability, 0.82)
9 bash scripts use `set -uo pipefail` without justification comment (project-standards, 0.88)
Stop hook transmits unredacted response to fast model — privacy not documented (security, adversarial, 0.88)
install.sh idempotency guard could false-positive on broad jq walk (correctness, 0.82)

Misc: double json.dumps, single-hop symlink resolve, safety-warn stderr invisible to user, no install lock, stdin no timeout, Stop-hook hangs on slow model, missing docstrings, comment-style nits, 9 commits >72 chars (will be squashed — moot)
fix_priority_order: P1-1 (call_id pairing) — correctness, breaks documented schema
P1-4 (redaction bypass DB_PASSWORD/URL/PAT/STS) — security, real-world exposure
P1-2 (hooks merge data loss) — install-time silent data loss for users
P1-10 (python3-absent install corruption) — install-time settings.json deletion
P1-3 (pattern duplication shared module) — closes drift class permanently
P1-9 (docs point to wrong file) — closes the trap that caused the original Authorization-header bug
P1-5 P1-6 P1-7 P1-8 P1-test-6 (test coverage gaps) — regression-prevention for above
P2 safe_auto items as time permits
residual_risks: Redaction patterns silently diverge between redact.py and log_tool_call.py copy (until P1-3 lands)
Concurrent identical tool calls in same session collide on pair_path — may matter under AGENT_TEAMS
settings.json hooks merge overwrites existing user hook lists — backup exists but loss is silent
Database URL passwords and compound env-var passwords persist in JSONL logs at full fidelity for up to 365 days until P1-4 lands
testing_gaps: Pair-file round-trip (create on pre, consume on post) untested
Cross-pattern-file consistency between redact.py and log_tool_call.py untested
agent_native_gaps: P1-9: docs/LOGGING.md procedure for adding redaction patterns points to redact.py, but live pipeline is log_tool_call.py — agents adding a pattern get a passing test and a still-leaking log
P2 #13: scripts/redact-existing-logs.py referenced in docs but not present — agents get file-not-found
P3 #31: validate.sh doesn't check log file recency — agents can't distinguish 'logging working' from 'logging silently broken'
deployment_notes: P1-2 means existing users with custom hooks lose them on first install — release note required
P1-10 means a system without python3 corrupts the install — fix or document required-tools check before merge
learnings_summary: No docs/solutions/ directory exists in repo (this is the first feature on the branch). Repo's own docs/HOOKS.md and docs/LOGGING.md are the authoritative learnings substrate going forward.
